C44993.observed: What was checked: that the Add Part button is taken away once a job reaches a stage where it should no longer be changed. What happened: it is taken away on two of those stages and left in place on the third. On a Paid job there is no Add Part button anywhere on the page, and on a Complete job there is none either. On a DECLINED job all four Add Part buttons are still there and still work, and a part added on one does save. For comparison, on the same job while it was open and editable the same four buttons were found, so the check does see them when they are there.

C45035.observed: What was checked: that if a job is closed to changes while somebody has a part open for editing, pressing Save is refused and they are told to refresh. The job was then moved to Declined, which should close it to changes. Save was pressed. No warning appeared - there was no message saying the job can no longer be edited and nothing telling the user to refresh - and the row simply closed as though the change had been accepted.
